scope.description: Six tracked provenance changes plus the explicitly requested untracked integration test.

verified: Inspected production wiring: SdkContext creates the GA sink and retains buildStamp-derived build/app_version; the release pipeline compiles web assets before native version/build stamping.

Native identity is acquired before GA initialization, cached, stamped onto queued and subsequent events without mutating the original envelope, and prioritized before the existing 20-field compaction limit. Existing per-event allowlists and forbidden-identifier filtering remain in place.
App-info rejection, invalid identity, and timeout use the existing bounded retry/drop policy. Queue bounds, SDK-candidate reuse, session adoption, and truthful flush diagnostics remain intact.

The integration test passed for both games. Replaying the baseline sink/allowlist failed for both at native-analytics-provenance.integration.mjs:116 because native_app_version was undefined. This is a meaningful regression test, not an assertion that merely validates its fixtures.
Analytics-focused tests: Dog 70 passed, 2 skipped; Bird 69 passed, 3 skipped. git diff --check passed.

testing_gaps.detail: The test manually composes the facade and source stamp rather than invoking production SdkContext/buildStamp. It proves compiled sink/mapper/Capacitor-JS propagation, not full bootstrap or archive fidelity.
testing_gaps.suggested_test: Add a compiled production-composition assertion if this test is later used as a bootstrap/source-stamp regression gate.

testing_gaps.detail: Optional hardening: cover failed-then-successful App.getInfo recovery with queued session_start/session_end/session_start, and a crowded allowed-field payload that retains native plus source identity while remaining within 20 fields.

coverage.lenses: Correctness, testing, API compatibility, reliability, adversarial fidelity, project standards, and ce-simplify-code reuse/quality/efficiency.
coverage.limitation: All lenses ran inline. Child reviewers, independent validators, and cross-model review were unavailable under the delegated no-children constraint.
coverage.simplification: No behavior-preserving simplification worth expanding this surgical diff was identified.
coverage.test_limitations: Existing skipped tests and Node localStorage experimental warnings remain. No device, signing, release, provider-delivery, or real Info.plist execution was performed; physical proof remains Store-owned.

artifact_note: No review artifact was written, honoring the explicit read-only/no-edits request.
